correctness.rationale: Cayley labeled-tree EGF and Lagrange inversion give the unrooted two-component normalizer, while Prüfer codes give the exact conditioned degree law. An explicit adjacent-binomial ratio proves strict LR order, edge-addition bijection and vertex-exchangeability give covariance -2(n-2)/(n+6), and the cited established two-vertex floating inclusion formula gives Var(S) and the correlation limit. Exact rational exhaustive forest enumeration n=2..8 (215290 distinct forests) passes 240 analytic checks. The infinite proof does not rest on enumeration.

value.rationale: Component fragmentation and vertex degree are central local/global observables in random spanning forests. Strict conditional likelihood-ratio ordering supplies a full distributional dependence statement; the exact covariance tends to -2 although the correlation decays at the n^-1/2 scale. This nonvanishing mixed-moment signal is not determined by the already known marginal size moments and is useful for conditional sampling and local/global dependence analysis.
